configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native (dev box / build on the Pi)

configurePresets.name: arm64
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for aarch64 against this container's libraries (deployable)
configurePresets.description: The normal way to build for a Pi. The devcontainer is Debian Bookworm, so its cross toolchain targets the same glibc 2.36 as Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm and libduet_sbc.so from this preset loads there as-is. No sysroot and no Pi needed.

configurePresets.name: arm64-sysroot
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for aarch64 against a Pi sysroot (older targets only)
configurePresets.description: Only needed to target a glibc older than the container's 2.36 - an earlier Pi OS release, say. For Bookworm use arm64. Links against a sysroot copied from the target, so requires pi-sysroot/ to exist: fetch it with scripts/fetch-pi-sysroot.sh <user>@<pi-host>, or override the path with -DDUET_SBC_SYSROOT=...

configurePresets.name: armhf
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for 32-bit armhf against this container's libraries (deployable)
configurePresets.description: As arm64, for a 32-bit Raspberry Pi OS install. Same glibc reasoning: the devcontainer is Debian Bookworm, so libduet_sbc.so from this preset loads on a Bookworm Pi as-is.

configurePresets.name: armhf-sysroot
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for 32-bit armhf against a Pi sysroot (older targets only)
configurePresets.description: As arm64-sysroot, for a 32-bit Raspberry Pi OS install. Requires pi-sysroot/, or override the path with -DDUET_SBC_SYSROOT=...

configurePresets.name: native-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Native, unoptimised with full debug info

configurePresets.name: arm64-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for aarch64, unoptimised with full debug info
configurePresets.description: What scripts/debug-on-pi.sh builds for the jitter harness: statically linked, so it needs no sysroot and runs under gdbserver on any Pi OS release.

configurePresets.name: arm64-sysroot-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for aarch64 against a Pi sysroot, unoptimised with full debug info
configurePresets.description: As arm64-sysroot, for targeting an older glibc than the container's. Requires pi-sysroot/ as arm64-sysroot does.

configurePresets.name: armhf-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for 32-bit armhf, unoptimised with full debug info
configurePresets.description: As armhf. Every deployable preset has a -debug twin so that scripts/build.sh --build-type Debug can pick one whatever the architecture.

configurePresets.name: armhf-sysroot-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for 32-bit armhf against a Pi sysroot, unoptimised with full debug info
configurePresets.description: As armhf-sysroot, for targeting an older glibc than the container's. Requires pi-sysroot/ as armhf-sysroot does.
